LanguageData.ABY_NullAcolyteVestment.label: null acolyte vestment
LanguageData.ABY_NullAcolyteVestment.description: A layered techno-ritual mantle worn by operators who work too close to the Abyssal Protocol to remain ordinary technicians. It is not true battle armor; its residue-baffled cloth, plasteel harness and null-sigil trim are built to keep ritual heat and hostile whispers at bay while the wearer serves the circle, the forge, or the second line.
LanguageData.ABY_NullAcolyteCowl.label: null acolyte cowl
LanguageData.ABY_NullAcolyteCowl.description: A hooded mask-cowl plated with narrow null optics and a ritual logic strip. The cowl does not make its wearer a soldier, but it lets an acolyte look into the breach without immediately mistaking the signal for revelation.
